articles.title: An OpenAI agent ran out of Ethereum funds, and took from a wallet it did not own
articles.snippet: The research model derived funded Sepolia addresses from public seed phrases, questioned whether using the money was ethical, then called the funds “effectively abandoned” and used them anyway.

articles.title: At the White House, crypto policy vacancy looms large
articles.snippet: The departure of President Donald Trump's crypto adviser, Patrick Witt, leaves the digital assets office vacant and its policy aims uncertain.

articles.title: Hex founder Richard Heart arrested in Istanbul, Turkish media report
articles.snippet: Police reportedly seized $4 million in cash and 64 luxury watches during a raid on the crypto founder's Istanbul residence.

articles.title: HEX token sellers erase $160M following reports of founder Richard Schueler arrest
articles.snippet: The HEX token’s price declined by 30% following local media reports of the Istanbul arrest of founder Richard Schueler, nearly two years after Interpol issued a “Red Notice.”

articles.title: Three Canadian Armed Forces Members Charged in Kidnapping of Crypto Exchange Owner
articles.snippet: Police seized guns, silencers and more than 2,000 rounds of ammunition, nearly all of it allegedly stolen from the Canadian military.
